notes: `בְּאֶרֶץ הַחַיִּים` → *in the land of the living* is rule 29's arthrous case, not a fronting: the ASV writes a *the* before each English noun, so the article takes the one standing before its own word and the construct noun takes the supplied one, with the relational *of* going to the rectum under rule 19.

`אַתָּה מַחְסִי` divides under rule 20: the explicit pronoun takes only its own *Thou* and the construction-supplied copula joins the nominal predicate, discontinuous around the possessive under rule 25.
The supplied *O* before *Jehovah* joins the vocative's own unit under rule 36 and is never `added`.
